name: the telling clause not shown at the design: informed members reject the planned change
what_it_changes: P05's added clause says that a planned change is repaired away until its keepers are told. In these rooms the lines limit the clause where the design is settled. About half say that members who know of the change reject it, so repair or recolouring enforces a competing design, and telling does not settle it. The others say the record does not show the untold keepers, the agreed change or the loss that the clause needs. The frozen clause holds here only in part.
why: Cut rules R1 and R2 (tree-D4.md), with R1a (the level): the key's lines, read whole in _analysis/d4a02_keys/restrict_P05_T4-006.txt, state one shared change to P05. R1a: T3-004 (settling the mark's design) holds 47 of the 59 rooms, under 80 per cent, so the branch is declared at the fourth order. 'Informing keepers of an agreed colour does not secure acceptance when a participant explicitly rejects the vote after being told its result' (AyyMD); 'When keepers explicitly reject a proposed design, restoration can enforce competing commitments rather than result from not being told' (flashtv); 'The information-failure explanation requires evidence of an agreed change, reversal, and failed communication' (coldplay). Two lines are the re-check corrections of polska and satania (F-024). These are the labelers' how sentences.
